WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT * FROM lfl_sales ORDER BY fiscal_year

WITH n AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(v) v FROM n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.dt WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 GROUP BY ALL),
ctl AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date WHERE c.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT coalesce(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, coalesce(m.fiscal_week,c.fiscal_week) wk, coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) st, m.v, c.c, round(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.c,0),2) gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week, store_id)
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.c,0))>1 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
  count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line_id, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id||'-'||f.line_no) AS dist_receipt_line,
  min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_loaded, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_loaded, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS load_stamps
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ret, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist_sales_line, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900 AND is_current) AS current_physical_stores,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) AS all_physical
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
